items.description: Struck by two uncrewed aerial devices (one in the engine room and the other in the forward section) causing the crew to abandon the ship. All crew members were rescued by another ship with no injuries. Request for assistance to the IMO from Yemen (26/02) to respond to oil pollution. The M/V RUBYMAR sank on Saturday, 2 March 2024, 16 miles west of the port of Mocha, in the eastern part of Yemen.

items.description: Struck by an uncrewed surface device on the port side by the engine room that caused flooding. And then struck again by an uncrewed aerial device on the starboard side, resulting in not under command. One crew member is unaccounted for. The remaining crew were rescued by a navy ship. On 18th June, the vessel sank.
